{{Top|leg}}
The '''Home Planet Mine''' was a large mine on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] controlled by [[Arcona Mineral Harvest Corporation]]. The mine mainly produced only [[azurite]]. Named for the [[Home Planet Party]], it was working with the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] to restore the ecosystem on Bandomeer in the years prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xanatos]] had attempted to sabotage the mine, planting a bomb within, hoping to lure his former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to his death. However, it was discovered that a large vein of [[ionite]] existed in the mine; this metal both nullified the bomb and ensured that the mine would not be closed by [[Offworld Mining Corporation|Offworld Mining Company]]. Some sections of the mine include [[K region]] and [[K-7]] within it, as well as [[Core 5|Cores 5]], [[Core 6|6]], [[Core 7|7]], [[Core 8|8]], [[Core 9|9]] and [[Core 10|10]].<ref name="Dark Rival">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]''</ref>
